Here’s the full integrated 12-week muscle-gain plan for your 26-year-old, strict vegan client with full gym access—combining lifting, intensified Phase 3 overlays, cardio, nutrition (150 g plant protein/day), recovery, and weekly structure. Use as a clear playbook.

Program overview
- Duration: 12 weeks, 3 phases with built-in deloads and progressive overload
- Split: 4 lifting days/week (Upper A, Lower A, Upper B, Lower B); optional Day 5 accessories/mobility
- Cardio: 2 sessions/week (Zone 2 base + short intervals/tempo), periodized to avoid interference
- Progression: Double progression (add reps, then load 1–2%); RIR managed 1–3 in Phases 1–2; Phase 3 intensifies to 0–2 RIR on primaries
- Deloads: Week 4 relative deload; Week 9 light deload/primer
- Nutrition: ~150 g protein/day from plants; small surplus (+200–300 kcal over maintenance), creatine, B12, DHA/EPA
- Flexibility: 1 weekly “cheat meal” (still vegan), post-hard lift, with guardrails

Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Foundation Hypertrophy and Technique
- Goal: Groove patterns, establish volume, build base; 8–12 reps most work
- RIR: 1–3 on almost all sets
- Rest: 2–3 min compounds; 60–90 s accessories

Weekly sessions (Weeks 1–3)
Upper A
- Flat Barbell Bench 4x8–10
- Chest-Supported Row 4x8–12
- Seated DB Shoulder Press 3x8–12
- Lat Pulldown 3x10–12
- Cable Fly 3x12–15
- EZ-Bar Curl 3x10–12
- Rope Triceps Pressdown 3x10–12

Lower A
- High-Bar Back Squat 4x8–10
- Romanian Deadlift 4x8–10
- Leg Press 3x10–12
- Walking DB Lunge 3x10/leg
- Seated Leg Curl 3x12–15
- Standing Calf Raise 4x10–12
- Plank 3x45–60 s

Upper B
- Incline DB Bench 4x8–10
- One-Arm DB Row 4x8–12/side
- Landmine or Arnold Press 3x10–12
- Assisted Pull-Ups or Neutral Pulldown 3x8–12
- Cable Lateral Raise 3x12–15
- Incline DB Curl 3x10–12
- Overhead Rope Extension 3x10–12

Lower B
- Deadlift (conv or trap) 4x6–8
- Front Squat or Goblet 3x8–10
- Barbell Hip Thrust 4x8–10 (2 s squeeze)
- Bulgarian Split Squat 3x8–10/leg
- Leg Extension 3x12–15
- Seated Calf Raise 4x12–15
- Hanging Knee Raise 3x10–12

Optional Day 5 (light): Laterals, face pulls, arms, tibialis 3x15 each + 20 min easy bike + mobility

Week 4 (relative deload)
- Reduce sets ~30%; keep loads ~90–92.5% of Week 3; focus on pristine technique and slower eccentrics

Cardio in Phase 1
- Week 1: Two Zone 2 sessions, 25–30 min each (bike/incline walk/row)
- Week 2: 30–35 min both; add 4 x 15–20 s easy strides once
- Week 3: 35–40 min one session; 30 min + 6 x 10 s fast spins the other
- Week 4: Reduce to 2 x 20–30 min Zone 2 only (no intensity)

Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Overload and Volume Emphasis
- Goal: Heavier top sets + back-offs, more accessory volume; 6–10 reps primary, 10–15 accessories
- Introduce one safe intensifier per session (myo-reps or small drop-set on isolation)

Weekly sessions (sample Week 5; Weeks 6–7 progress reps/load; Week 8 trims accessories ~20%)
Upper A
- Bench Press: 1 top set 6–8 (1–2 RIR), 2 back-offs 8–10 (−5–7%)
- Chest-Supported Row 4x8–10
- Seated DB Press 4x8–10
- Lat Pulldown 3x10–12
- Cable Fly 3x12–15 (last set drop-set)
- EZ-Bar Curl 3x10–12 + myo-set
- Rope Pressdown 3x10–12

Lower A
- High-Bar Squat: 1 top 6–8; 3 back-offs 8–10
- RDL 4x8–10
- Leg Press 4x10–12
- Leg Curl 3x10–12 (last set drop)
- Standing Calf 5x8–12 (2–3 s peak)
- Ab Wheel 3x10–12

Upper B
- Incline DB Bench 4x8–10
- Pull-Ups (weighted/assisted) 4x6–8
- Landmine Press 3x8–10
- Cable Row 3x10–12
- Lateral Raise 4x12–15 (partials after failure on last set)
- Incline DB Curl 3x10–12
- Overhead Rope Extension 3x10–12

Lower B
- Deadlift: 1 top 5–6; 2 back-offs 6–8 (−7–10%)
- Hip Thrust 4x8–10 (2 s squeeze)
- Front Squat 3x6–8
- Bulgarian Split Squat 3x8–10/leg
- Leg Extension 3x12–15
- Seated Calf 4x12–15
- Hanging Leg Raise 3x10–12

Cardio in Phase 2
- Week 5: Zone 2 35–40 min; Bike intervals 6 x 45 s hard (RPE 8) / 90 s easy (total 30–35 min with warm-up/cool-down)
- Week 6: Zone 2 40 min; Rower 7 x 45 s hard / 75 s easy
- Week 7: Zone 2 40–45 min; Tempo 12–15 min at RPE 6–7 (within 40 min total)
- Week 8: Reduce volume ~15–20%; Zone 2 30–35 min; Bike intervals 5 x 45 s / 90 s

Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Intensification and Specialization
- Goal: Push intensity smartly—heavier top sets, strategic back-offs, controlled intensifiers; glute/delt/upper-back focus
- RIR: Primaries 0–2; back-offs 1–2; isolations can reach 0 with strict form
- Advanced methods: Rest-pause or myo-reps on one secondary compound per session; lengthened partials or slow eccentrics on last isolation set
- Safety: Spot/rails for squats/bench; straps for heavy pulls/rows; cap true-failure sets at 2–3 per session (machines/DBs/isolation)

Week 9 (light deload into intensification)
- Compounds: 1 top set 5–7 reps @ 1–2 RIR; 2 back-offs 6–8 @ ~2 RIR
- Accessories: Fewer sets; straight sets only
- Cardio: Zone 2, 30–35 + 25–30 min (no hard intervals)

Week 10
Upper A (pressing bias)
- Bench: Top 5–6 @ 0–1 RIR; 3x6–8 back-offs (−6–8%)
- Chest-Supported Row: 4x6–8; last set rest-pause
- Seated DB Press: 3x6–8; final set myo-reps (activation 12 @ 1 RIR, then 4x3–4)
- Lat Pulldown: 3x6–8 strict
- Finisher: Face Pull 2x15 + 6–8 lengthened partials

Lower A (quad bias)
- High-Bar Squat: Top 5–6 @ 0–1 RIR; 3x6–8 back-offs
- Hack/Leg Press: 3x8–10; last set rest-pause
- RDL: 3x6–8 @ 1–2 RIR
- Walking Lunge: 2–3x10/leg
- Calves: 4x8–12 (2 s top holds); last set drop −15% to clean reps

Upper B (pull bias)
- Pull-Ups: 5x5–6 (last set 0–1 RIR)
- Incline DB Bench: 3x6–8; last set myo-reps
- Single-Arm Cable Row: 3x8–10 with 1 s squeeze; last set lengthened partials
- Landmine Press: 3x6–8 heavy
- Rear-Delt Fly: 2x15 + 1 slow-eccentric set (10 reps @ 4 s down)

Lower B (hinge/glute bias)
- Deadlift: Top 3–5 @ 0–1 RIR; 2x5–6 back-offs (−6–8%)
- Hip Thrust: 3x6–8 (2–3 s squeeze); last set rest-pause
- Front Squat: 3x6–8 @ 1–2 RIR
- Split Squat: 2–3x8/leg
- Calves: 4x10–12; last set slow-eccentric

Week 11
- Compounds: 2 top sets 4–6 @ 0–1 RIR; 2 back-offs 6–8 @ 1–2 RIR
- One secondary compound per session gets rest-pause; others straight sets
- Reduce isolation volume by ~10%
- Cardio: Zone 2 35–40 min; Short tempo 10–12 min within ~35–40 min total

Week 12 (peak week)
- Primaries: 1 AMRAP in target range (stop at first technical breakdown), then −10% for 2x6–8 with 3 s eccentrics
- Secondaries: Only one intensifier per session
- Isolations: 1–2 sets each; last set to technical failure with lengthened partials; otherwise taper ~15–20%
- Cardio: Zone 2 30–35 min; 6 x 30 s hard / 90 s easy on bike/rower (reduce reps if bar speed lags)

Weekly schedule example (integrating cardio)
- Mon: Upper A (+ optional 10–15 min easy spin cooldown)
- Tue: Lower A + Session A Zone 2 (or move to Wed if legs cooked)
- Wed: Rest or Session A Zone 2 if not done Tue
- Thu: Upper B (+ optional 10–12 min easy walk)
- Fri: Lower B + Session B (intervals) or push to Sat
- Sat: Intervals if not done Fri; optional 20–30 min easy walk
- Sun: Rest

Vegan nutrition (hit ~150 g protein/day; small surplus)
- Calories: Start ~+200–300 kcal above maintenance; adjust ±150–200 kcal based on weekly weight trend (+0.25–0.5% BW/week) and gym performance
- Macros (starting point): Protein 150 g; Fats 60–75 g; Carbs 260–360 g
- Protein distribution: 4–5 feedings with 25–40 g protein each; prioritize soy or pea+rice blends for ~2–3 g leucine/meal
- Supplements:
  - Creatine monohydrate 3–5 g/day
  - Vitamin B12: 1,000 µg 2–3x/week or 250–500 µg daily
  - Algal oil DHA/EPA 250–500 mg/day
  - Consider iodine (150 µg/day via iodized salt or supplement) and iron intake with vitamin C sources
- Hydration: 30–40 ml/kg/day; add 500–750 ml around training

Protein powder recommendations
- Best all-around: Pea + rice blend with third-party testing (e.g., Transparent Labs Vegan, Legion Plant+)
- Budget and complete: NOW Sports Soy Isolate
- Dose/use: 1–2 scoops/day to help reach 150 g; pair with fortified soy milk post-workout

Post-workout meal ideas (25–40 g protein + 60–90 g carbs)
- Shake: 1–1.5 scoops plant protein + 300 ml soy milk + banana + oats
- Tofu burrito bowl: 200 g tofu, rice, black beans, salsa
- Tempeh stir-fry: 150–180 g tempeh + white rice + veggies
- Soy yogurt parfait: 300 g soy yogurt + 1 scoop protein + granola/berries

High-protein breakfasts (30–45 g protein)
- Protein oats with soy milk + 1 scoop plant protein
- Tofu scramble bagel
- Soy yogurt parfait with added scoop
- Tempeh breakfast burrito
- Smoothie (1–1.5 scoops protein + oats + banana)

Cheat meal (weekly, plant-based)
- Frequency: 1 flexible meal/week (not a full day)
- Timing: After hardest lower-day (Fri/Sat)
- Guardrails: Keep day at maintenance to +300–500 kcal; ensure ≥35–50 g protein in the cheat meal; moderate fats (20–35 g)
- Ideas: Vegan pizza with tofu/seitan; double-patty seitan/Impossible burger + fries; Tex-Mex with double tofu/beans; sushi night + edamame
- Tactics: Front-load 60–80 g protein earlier that day; 10–20 min walk after meal; hydrate

Warm-up, mobility, recovery
- Warm-up: 5–8 min light cardio + dynamic mobility + 2–3 ramp-up sets for first two lifts
- Cool-down: 5 min easy cycle/row + targeted stretches (hips, T-spine, pecs/lats, ankles)
- Mobility: 10–12 min after sessions; optional 5–10 min foam rolling on tight areas
- Sleep: 7.5–9 hours nightly; consistent schedule
- Stress: 5–10 min breathwork or light mindfulness daily

Progress tracking and adjustments
- Logbook: Loads, reps, RIR, notes on bar speed/joint feel
- Bodyweight: 3–4x/week morning average; aim +0.25–0.5%/week
- If weight stalls 2 weeks: add +100–150 kcal/day (mostly carbs)
- If recovery lags: trim 1–2 accessory sets/session or reduce interval reps first
- Joint tolerance: Swap equivalents as needed (hack ↔ pendulum; bench ↔ machine press; RDL ↔ hinge machine)

Execution checklist
- Hit 30–40 g protein at breakfast and post-workout
- Keep most working sets 1–3 RIR (Phases 1–2); push to 0–2 RIR in Phase 3 primaries
- Cardio: 90–150 min/week total, scaled by phase and recovery
- One PR (rep or load) per session target in Phase 3
- Honor deloads in Weeks 4 and 9

This integrated plan gives you a complete, periodized roadmap to build muscle, maintain cardio fitness, and meet vegan nutrition needs, with clear week-by-week structure and Phase 3 intensity upgrades.

Global cardio principles
- Total weekly: 90–150 min mixed modalities (low-intensity base + short intervals)
- Surfaces/modalities: Bike, incline treadmill walk, rowing erg, elliptical, or outdoor brisk walks. Avoid excessive running volume if shin/knee tolerance is unknown.
- Intensity anchors:
  - Zone 2 (easy aerobic): RPE 4–6/10; conversational pace, 60–70% HRmax
  - Tempo (upper aerobic): RPE 6–7/10; steady but non-gasping
  - HIIT/Intervals: RPE 8–9/10; hard efforts with full control
- Placement: Prioritize lifting quality
  - On lower-body days: do cardio after lifting or on a separate day.
  - On upper-body days: low-intensity cardio can be before or after; if before, keep it light and brief.
- Progression: Build minutes first, then selectively add intensity. Keep 1 easy week during deloads.

Weeks 1–4 (Foundation + Aerobic Base)
Goal: Build habit and base without interfering with lifts.

Week 1
- Session A (Zone 2): 25–30 min bike or incline walk, non-lifting day or after Upper A. RPE 4–5.
- Session B (Zone 2): 25–30 min rower or elliptical after Lower B or on rest day. RPE 4–5.
- Optional recovery walk: 30–40 min easy outdoor walk once on the weekend.

Week 2
- Session A: 30–35 min Zone 2.
- Session B: 30–35 min Zone 2.
- Strides (technique speed, not sprints): After one Zone 2 walk—4 x 15–20 s brisk strides on flat with 60–90 s easy walk between.

Week 3
- Session A: 35–40 min Zone 2.
- Session B: 30 min Zone 2 + 6 x 10 s fast spin on bike with 50 s easy between (very light legs, just neuromuscular).
- Optional: 20–25 min easy cycle on the optional Day 5 accessories session.

Week 4 (Deload week for lifting; reduce cardio volume 20–30%)
- Session A: 25–30 min Zone 2 only.
- Session B: 20–25 min Zone 2 only.
- No strides/fast spins this week.

Weeks 5–8 (Build Capacity + Introduce Intervals)
Goal: Maintain base and add short, controlled intervals to improve VO2 without leg DOMS.

Week 5
- Session A: 35–40 min Zone 2 (bike or treadmill 4–6% incline).
- Session B (Intro intervals, low impact): Bike—6 x 45 s at RPE 8 with 90 s easy spin. 10 min easy warm-up + 8–10 min cool-down. Total ~30–35 min.
- Optional: 25–30 min Zone 2 walk on a rest day if recovery is good.

Week 6
- Session A: 40 min Zone 2.
- Session B: Rower—7 x 45 s hard (RPE 8) / 75 s easy. Total ~32–36 min including warm-up/cool-down.

Week 7
- Session A: 40–45 min Zone 2 (keep it truly conversational).
- Session B (Tempo alternative): 15 min warm-up, 12–15 min continuous tempo at RPE 6–7, 10 min cool-down. Total ~40 min.
- Optional: 20 min easy spin post-Upper B as a flush.

Week 8 (Taper cardio volume ~15–20%, maintain one quality stimulus)
- Session A: 30–35 min Zone 2.
- Session B: Bike intervals—5 x 45 s hard / 90 s easy (reduced reps).

Weeks 9–12 (Maintain Aerobic Fitness, Sharpen with Short Intervals)
Goal: Keep cardio supportive; keep legs fresh for heavier top sets.

Week 9 (lighter overall)
- Session A: 30–35 min Zone 2.
- Session B: 25–30 min Zone 2.
- No hard intervals this week.

Week 10
- Session A: 35–40 min Zone 2 (prefer non-impact: bike or elliptical).
- Session B: 8 x 30 s hard (RPE 8–9) / 90 s easy on bike. 10 min warm-up, 8–10 min cool-down. Total ~35–38 min.

Week 11
- Session A: 35–40 min Zone 2.
- Session B (short tempo): 12 min warm-up, 10–12 min tempo RPE 6–7, 8–10 min cool-down.

Week 12
- Session A: 30–35 min Zone 2.
- Session B: 6 x 30 s hard / 90 s easy on bike or rower. Keep it crisp; stop 1 rep earlier than failure feeling.

Coordination with lifting days
- Example weekly layout:
  - Mon: Upper A + optional 10–15 min easy spin cool-down
  - Tue: Lower A then Session A cardio (Zone 2) OR place Session A on Wed
  - Wed: Rest or Session A if not done Tue
  - Thu: Upper B + optional 10–12 min easy walk
  - Fri: Lower B then Session B (intervals) OR Sat morning intervals
  - Sat: If not done Fri, do Session B; otherwise optional easy walk 20–30 min
  - Sun: Rest

Recovery safeguards
- If leg soreness is high: move intervals to a non-lower day or swap to upper-body–friendly erg (ski erg, assault bike arms-only bias).
- Keep intervals seated (bike) to reduce eccentric load and interference with squats/deads.
- Cap total weekly cardio at ~120 min during the heaviest lifting weeks if performance dips.

Fueling and hydration around cardio
- Pre easy cardio: small carb snack if fasted (e.g., banana or dates).
- Pre intervals: 20–40 g carbs 30–60 min prior.
- Post: Combine with planned meals; no need for extra protein beyond her 150 g/day.
- Hydration: 400–600 ml water before sessions; sip during longer sessions. Add electrolytes if >45 min or in heat.

Progress tracking
- Resting heart rate (morning), perceived exertion at set paces, and ability to maintain conversation in Zone 2.
- If lifts stall, first reduce interval volume (fewer reps) before touching Zone 2 minutes.
